subject: general
question: The Panchayati Raj Institutions DO NOT exist in which of the following states as on June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Nagaland'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• Panchayati Raj Institution (PRI) is a system of rural local self-government in India.
 
• Panchayati Raj system was added to the Indian constitution by the 73rd amendment act 1992.
 
• The amendment added a new part IX consisting of 16 Articles and the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution.
 
• According to article 243 M of the Indian constitution, Panchayati Raj System is not applicable to certain areas.
 
• The system has three levels: Gram Panchayat (village level), Mandal Parishad or Block Samiti or Panchayat Samiti (block level), and Zila Parishad (district level).
 
• The Panchayati Raj system exists in all states except **Nagaland**, **Meghalaya**, and **Mizoram**, and **in all Union Territories except Delh**i.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In 1882 Lord Rippon provided the democratic framework to local governance. This gave him the title of “father of local self-government in India”.
 
• Some of the important committees related to the Panchayati raj system are -
 
 
• ​Hanumantha Rao Committee (1983)
 
• G.V.K Rao committee (1985)
 
• L.M. Singhvi Committee (1986)
 
• Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957)
 
• Ashok Mehta committee (1977)
 
• Thungan committee (1989)
 
 
 
• 24 April is celebrated as National Panchayati Raj day.
 
• Panchayat was first introduced in Rajasthan.
 
• Panchayati Raj bill was passed during Narasimha Rao Government.
 
• The duration of the Elected panchayat is 5 years.
 
• Election of Panchayat-
 
 
• Before the expiry of the 5-year duration of the current panchayat.
 
• In case of dissolution of Panchayat before the expiry of 6 months period
